_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Repair/Modification/Overhaul Status Report
summary: The Repair/Modification/Overhaul Status Report provides information on contractual maintenance programs applicable to military equipment.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) provides information on contractual maintenance programs applicable to military equipment.
a. This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
b. This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-80933.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Repair/Modification/Overhaul Status Report shall be in a contractor selected format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Repair/Modification/Overhaul Status Report content shall be as follows:

children.title: National Stock Number for each item prior to work.
Program quantity for each National Stock Number item.
Quantity completed to date on each National Stock Number item.
Work in process quantity on each National Stock Number item.
Unserviceable on hand quantity to date on each National Stock Number item.
Identification and explanation of delays, accelerations, and problems.
